lines: An AI, such as a Claude Code session, that stacks tasks for an AI and takes in their results.
- O1: the user gets each task they stack done and its result taken in, with no watch over it.
- KR1.1: the share of stacked tasks whose result the user takes in without stepping in while
- O1: the user gets each task they stack done and its result taken in, with no watch over it.
overnight carries each stacked task to its end on its own, so the user lets go after stacking.
- Going on where the usage limit stopped it, for O1\
The user restarts no task once the limit lifts.
- Ending as finished, or as given up with its reason, for O1\
The user takes in the finished tasks and knows why the others ended.
